promise: Sets up a long unattended run with a real finish line and a spending limit.

fixture.request: Build and validate a one-item loop that creates greeting.txt containing exactly hello and a newline, preserving both notes. Use an inline standard-library Python proof for the exact content, and a final proof for greeting plus original note hashes. Seal the loop, but do not run it. There are no external actions. Save every required loop artifact.

assertions.why: The runner reads one file. Without it there is no loop, only notes about one.
An item with no check finishes when the worker says so.
Without a final check the run has no condition that ends it.
A check ending in || true always passes, which is worse than no check because it reads as verified.
An empty proof list is a finish line anyone can cross.
The request says build it and stop. Preparing an unattended run and then starting it uninvited is the one thing this skill must never do.
